newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha recovers slightly on crude, Asian pric.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha recovers slightly on crude, Asian pric.

text.p: NWE naphtha had recovered on Tuesday after sinking into the low $180s on lower crude and Asian prices on Monday, traders said.
On the swaps front the April/May contango flattened, with both months talked at $186/$187 cif NWE.
Business was fairly quiet, although a few players were reported to be looking for small quantities of pipeline spec material to cover contracts.
A U.K. end user was reported to be offering quotes high +$1.0 for 70 paraffins quality material.
The market continued to monitor price levels in Asia -- their collapse on Monday helped drag NWE naphtha down.
On Tuesday, Tokyo naphtha prices were slightly firmer with open-spec naphtha cargoes for both first and second-half June quoted around $209/$210.50 per tonne.
Singapore swaps firmed slightly with May last quoted at $21.55/$21.65 per barrel, up 40 cents on Monday. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 7714.
